reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant exploit, outage, exchange disruption, legal action, or near-term SOL supply event was identified for SOL as of September 27, 2026. Recent protocol changes are active but no associated incident was found.

facts.fact: Solana’s official status information shows Mainnet and listed service components operational, with no reported September incidents in the available status history. ([solana.statuspage.io](https://solana.statuspage.io/?utm_source=openai))

The September 18 official changelog reports Transaction V1, rent reduction, and 250 ms slot-time changes as mainnet feature gates; it does not report a live network fault or emergency rollback. ([solana.com](https://solana.com/news/solana-changelog-september-18-2026))

The most recent official infrastructure event located was an August 12 routing failure affecting about 29% of stake; Solana states block production continued and the provider recovered in just over 30 minutes. ([solana.com](https://solana.com/news/solana-building-trust-in-public))

Available unlock data indicates the next listed SOL staking-reward release is October 11, 2026—about 401,600 SOL weekly (0.068% of float)—rather than an immediate large discrete unlock. This schedule is partly forecast-based. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/solana))
